info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Ratings-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Ride Ratings Retrieval API enables clients to access and analyze ride ratings collected from users in real-time. This endpoint allows developers to fetch comprehensive ratings for rideshare services, providing essential insights into service quality and user satisfaction. Typical consumers of this API include rideshare companies, data analysts, and developers integrating user feedback into their applications. The data retrieved can be used for reporting, trend analysis, and to inform service improvements.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the ratings for rides based on user feedback. It provides an overview of the ratings system in place, which can be useful for understanding ride quality and user satisfaction.
